title: Copper ion-induced MYH9 polymerization executes cuproptosis
title_zh: 铜离子诱导的MYH9聚合执行杯胁细胞死亡
abstract: Cuproptosis is a recently identified form of copper-dependent cell death implicated in various physiological and pathological processes. However, the executive proteins involved and the role of physiological intracellular copper in cuproptosis remain unclear. Herein, we identified myosin heavy-chain 9 (MYH9) as a cuproptosis executioner. Copper binding induced MYH9 polymerization, which disrupted the actin cytoskeleton and led to cuproptotic cell death. Hexyl 2-(3,4,5-trihydroxy-phenyl) acetate (HThPA) was shown to induce cuproptosis by binding to the nuclear receptor Nur77, leading to depletion of copper chelate glutathione (GSH) and release of free copper from intracellular copper stores. Acetylation of MYH9 by acetyltransferase dihydrolipoamide S-acetyltransferase (DLAT) facilitated copper binding, regardless of its extracellular or intracellular origin. Physiological copper levels were higher in drug-resistant tumor cells and clinical samples, which increased the likelihood of HThPA-induced cuproptosis. These results elucidate the mechanisms underlying cuproptosis, establish MYH9 as an executioner, and propose a treatment strategy for drug-resistant tumors.
abstract_zh: 杯胁细胞死亡（cuproptosis）是一种新近发现的铜依赖性细胞死亡形式，涉及多种生理和病理过程。然而，参与执行的蛋白质及体内生理性细胞内铜在杯胁细胞死亡中的作用尚不清楚。我们在此鉴定了肌球蛋白重链9（MYH9）为杯胁细胞死亡的执行者。铜结合诱导MYH9聚合，破坏肌动蛋白细胞骨架，导致杯胁细胞死亡。己基2-(3,4,5-三羟基苯基)乙酸（HThPA）通过与核受体Nur77结合诱导杯胁细胞死亡，导致铜螯合谷胱甘肽（GSH）耗竭并释放细胞内铜储存的游离铜。肌球蛋白重链9的乙酰化由二氢硫辛酰胺S-乙酰转移酶（DLAT）完成，促进铜结合，无论其来源是细胞外还是细胞内。体内生理性铜水平在耐药肿瘤细胞和临床样本中更高，增加了HThPA诱导杯胁细胞死亡的可能性。这些结果阐明了杯胁细胞死亡的机制，确立了MYH9为执行者，并提出了针对耐药肿瘤的治疗策略。
